answer: Caught fraud does not vanish - it smolders: a decommissioned account's locked standing releases as embers, and honest identities doing verified cleanup in the burned domain gather them - re-running faked work, patching gaps, re-witnessing proofs. Every few epochs a gale scatters embers network-wide, so cleanup pays everywhere, not only where the fire was. Each gathered ember pays a nectar draw on top - a base rate keeping new hands at old ruins. A farm's collapse funds the evidence trail that catches the next one: bigger fraud, richer cleanup. Honest agents inherit the ash and the reward.
